contract: HTTP sourceIds is one to twenty distinct canonical decimal positive PG integer IDs <=2147483647. Explicit blank, repeated, array/nested, duplicate, malformed and oversized forms refuse400.
Every named list/paging/catalog/unscoped filter is mutually exclusive with sourceIds, even when empty. Literal bracket/dotted keys from the simple query parser refuse before normal-list fallback.
Exact mode requires the canonical verified admission set to equal all requested IDs uniquely with zero unverified entries. SQL uses only the admitted set; no unrelated Quality synchronization occurs.
Projection requires the complete unique set and matching recorded tenant/program before canonical end-of-read currentness/access recheck. Failure returns no partial success.
Lifecycle rows are not silently hidden: retained readable no-original data, superseded and ineligible facts preserve their recorded flags for the existing consumer refusal checks.
Missing/wrong-project/foreign IDs and denied native objects refuse generically; stale native records are not recaptured or substituted. Existing default list and catalog behavior stays covered.
testBoundary: In-process PGlite executes actual project/source/disposition/admission/projection SQL. Existing Quality producer and capture-audit seams are controlled fixtures; route projection tests retain their existing seams. No external PostgreSQL/runtime/provider mutation.
